SELECT MIN(chn.name) AS character_name, MIN(mi_idx.info) AS rating, MIN(t.title) AS complete_hero_movie
FROM complete_cast AS cc
INNER JOIN comp_cast_type AS cct1 ON cc.subject_id = cct1.id
INNER JOIN comp_cast_type AS cct2 ON cc.status_id = cct2.id
INNER JOIN char_name AS chn ON ci.person_role_id = chn.id
INNER JOIN cast_info AS ci ON cc.movie_id = ci.movie_id
INNER JOIN info_type AS it2 ON mi_idx.info_type_id = it2.id
INNER JOIN keyword AS k ON mk.keyword_id = k.id
INNER JOIN kind_type AS kt ON t.kind_id = kt.id
INNER JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON cc.movie_id = mi_idx.movie_id
INNER JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON cc.movie_id = mk.movie_id
INNER JOIN name AS n ON ci.person_id = n.id
INNER JOIN title AS t ON cc.movie_id = t.id
WHERE cct1.kind = 'cast'
  AND cct2.kind LIKE '%complete%'
  AND chn.name IS NOT NULL
  AND (chn.name LIKE '%man%' OR chn.name LIKE '%Man%')
  AND it2.info = 'rating'
  AND k.keyword IN ('superhero', 'marvel-comics', 'based-on-comic', 'tv-special', 'fight', 'violence', 'magnet', 'web', 'claw', 'laser')
  AND kt.kind = 'movie'
  AND t.production_year > 2000
